name: Tolling Swell
description: Toll a deep slow swell over the host so that the souls beneath it gather strength with each stroke.

name: Knell Purge
description: Toll a purging knell that drives curse and taint out of every ally within earshot.

name: Dissonant Burst
description: Burst a wall of jarring tone through a foe's rank so that their joined soul work breaks apart.

name: Pealing Mend
description: Peal a warm mending note over a wounded ally until the tears in their soul close.

name: Massed Concord
description: Mass the voices of a whole host into one concord under which every soul works at full measure.

name: Peal Recall
description: Peal the last recalling note over a fallen ally and draw their soul back within the short window.

name: Deep Sounding
description: Sound a deep note across a whole army and read the strength and mood of every soul in it.

name: Sundering Overtone
description: Drive a hard overtone through every ward and shield into the core of an opponent's soul.

name: Great Unison
description: Bind an entire host into one great unison so that its members share strength and clarity without loss.

name: Mending Canticle
description: Sing a vast canticle that mends the souls of every wounded ally across a wide field.

name: Silencing Toll
description: Toll a heavy note that presses the soul work of a whole foe rank down into silence.

name: Host Canticle
description: Raise the school canticle over a host with a reach and weight set by the Core of the master.

name: Shatter Pitch
description: Find the breaking pitch of every soul upon a field and sound it so they shatter to the destructive ceiling of a resonant master of this tier.

name: Total Unison
description: Draw every allied soul on a field into total unison and lend each the full strength of the host up to the ceiling of this tier.
